options: Are we building the right product?
Are we building the product right, i.e. against the specification?
questions.explanation: Verification compares to specified requirements; validation to stakeholder needs.

questions.prompt: If a system passes every test derived from its requirements, it is guaranteed to meet users' needs.
questions.explanation: The requirements themselves may be wrong or incomplete.

options: Reviewing code against a coding standard
Users trying a prototype to confirm it fits their work
Checking a design against the specification
questions.explanation: Validation checks fitness for real use.

questions.prompt: A warehouse scanning app meets every written requirement, but staff wear thick gloves and cannot press its small buttons. What happened?
options: Verification passed but validation failed: the requirements missed a real need
questions.explanation: The product matched the spec but not the real environment.

questions.prompt: Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.
options: Both can be static or dynamic
Acceptance testing is the most validation-focused level
Validation can only happen after release
questions.explanation: Validation can happen early with prototypes.

questions.prompt: A code review checking that a function matches its design document is mostly:
questions.explanation: It compares to a specification and does not execute code.

questions.prompt: A team finds after release that users do not need the feature at all although all tests passed. Which activity was missing earlier?
options: Early validation with users, such as prototype feedback
questions.explanation: Early validation reduces the chance of building the wrong thing.

questions.prompt: Requirement: 'Report generation shall complete in 30 seconds.' Users actually need results in under 5 seconds to use them live. Tests show 20 seconds. Which is true?
options: Verification passes; validation reveals the requirement is inadequate
questions.explanation: The system meets the spec but not the need.

questions.prompt: In the V-model, which pairing is the best match of development and test activity?
options: Business requirements with acceptance testing, detailed design with component testing
questions.explanation: Each development level pairs with a corresponding test level.
